title: 第24章 狗咬你一口难道你还要咬狗一口不成第25章 螳螂捕蝉黄雀在后
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 两个时辰后。
邢映雪的伤势已经恢復得差不多，没有继续停留，两人选择离开。
苏辰之所以出手相助邢映雪，除了他们来自同一个班级之外，也有些同情邢映雪。
算是同病相怜，都是被家族遗弃的人。
吼！
恐怖的吼声响彻虚空，数百头铁甲犀牛已经將两人团团围住，一个个闪烁著冰冷目光，死死盯著面前猎物。
释放血轮，苏辰手里握著虚幻剑影，將邢映雪护在身后，施展九劫剑诀，凌厉霸道的剑气荡漾开来，横扫四周。
同时面对数百头铁甲犀牛的围杀，苏辰不仅没有丝毫的惧意，反而显得很是兴奋，一边屠杀一边吞噬。
只要吞噬的力量足够，配合混沌吞噬诀和混沌体的叠加，相信很快就能够突破自身极限，顺利晋级到九级筑基境。
数十分钟后。
苏辰和邢映雪同时盘膝而坐，说道：“凝神静气，固守本源，不要抵挡我的力量灌入，你只需要吞噬即可。”
苏辰的意思很简单，就是以他的身体为媒介，吞噬铁甲犀牛的力量，等到藉助混沌吞噬诀炼化后，再传给邢映雪体內，相信不会有任何的反噬。
心里很是感激。
连家族都选择放弃了她，包括学院，她也被安排在最差初级班。
如今苏辰却愿意相助她，眼神有些迷离地看著。
苏辰在邢映雪心中的身影逐渐放大。
“不要乱想，赶快修炼。”
被苏辰紧紧握著手，邢映雪心里多少有些心猿意马，不断地告诉自己，这个时候自己胡乱想什么。
头顶上空逐渐凝聚出血轮，里面有著一只小鸟虚影，正是邢映雪所觉醒的鷓鴣血轮。
在苏辰的全力相助下，邢映雪的修为突破到了三级筑基境。
“苏学弟，怎么了？”
紧紧握著邢映雪的手，苏辰看著邢映雪头顶上空的血轮，惊讶地说道：“你的血轮有些猫腻，你要是信得过我，我来帮你。”
“苏学弟，请。”
当然相信。
如今的邢映雪，甚至不会相信家族的任何人，反而会相信面前苏辰。
体內的混沌体浮现而出，头顶上空凝聚出的剑血轮，却是覆盖了阴沉的吞噬血轮，並且苏辰开始运转混沌吞噬诀。
一股股吞噬气息，不断地涌入邢映雪体內，开始笼罩血轮。
痛苦的脸上爬满了汗珠，邢映雪咬牙坚持。
一股股吞噬力量，不断地吞噬著邢映雪的鷓鴣血轮，要不是她选择相信苏辰，还真的以为苏辰会对她不利。
“邢学姐，坚持住。”
content_en:
Two hours later.
Xing Yingxue's injury had almost recovered, so they chose to leave without staying any longer.
The reason why Su Chen came to help Xing Yingxue was that besides being from the same class, he also sympathized with Xing Yingxue.
They are all in the same boat, they are both abandoned by their families.
roar!
Terrifying roars resounded through the void, and hundreds of armored rhinoceroses had surrounded the two of them. Each of them stared at the prey in front of them with their cold eyes flashing.
Releasing the blood wheel, Su Chen held the illusory sword shadow in his hand, protected Xing Yingxue behind him, and used the Nine Tribulations Sword Technique. The fierce and domineering sword energy rippled out and swept around.
At the same time, facing hundreds of armored rhinoceros, Su Chen not only showed no fear, but also seemed very excited, killing and devouring them.
As long as the devouring power is enough, combined with the superposition of the Chaos Devouring Technique and the Chaos Body, I believe that I will soon be able to break through my own limits and successfully advance to the ninth level of foundation building.
Tens of minutes later.
Su Chen and Xing Yingxue sat cross-legged at the same time and said: "Concentrate your mind and energy, stick to your roots, don't resist the infusion of my power, you just need to devour it."
Su Chen's meaning is very simple, that is, to use his body as a medium to devour the power of the armored rhino, and then refine it with the help of the Chaos Devouring Technique, and then pass it on to Xing Yingxue's body. I believe there will be no backlash.
I am very grateful.
Even her family chose to give up on her, including the academy, and she was placed in the worst junior class.
Now Su Chen is willing to help her, looking at her with somewhat confused eyes.
Su Chen's figure in Xing Yingxue's heart gradually grew larger.
"Don't think too much and practice quickly."
Being held tightly by Su Chen's hand, Xing Yingxue felt somewhat distracted and kept telling herself what she was thinking about at this time.
The blood wheel gradually condensed above the head, and inside it was the shadow of a small bird, which was the partridge blood wheel awakened by Xing Yingxue.
With Su Chen's full help, Xing Yingxue's cultivation level broke through to the third level of foundation building.
"Huh?"
"Junior Su, what's wrong?"
Holding Xing Yingxue's hand tightly, Su Chen looked at the blood wheel above Xing Yingxue's head and said in surprise: "Your blood wheel is a little fishy. If you can trust me, I will help you."
"Junior Su, please."
Of course I believe it.
Today, Xing Yingxue will not even trust anyone in the family, but will trust Su Chen in front of her.
The chaotic body in the body emerged, and the sword blood wheel condensed above the head covered the gloomy swallowing blood wheel, and Su Chen began to run the chaos swallowing technique.
Wave after wave of devouring aura continuously poured into Xing Yingxue's body and began to cover the blood wheel.
With beads of sweat covering her painful face, Xing Yingxue gritted her teeth and persisted.
Waves of devouring power kept devouring Xing Yingxue's blood chakra. If she hadn't chosen to believe in Su Chen, she would have really thought that Su Chen would be detrimental to her.
"Sister Xing, hold on."
"Yeah."
